summary.zh: 差异 HDX-MS 可连接蛋白构象群体与实验交换信号。本期方法把多个状态的结构集合和共同氘损失联合建模，为缺少损失校正对照的数据提供结构解释思路。
summary.en: Differential HDX-MS connects protein conformational populations with experimental exchange signals. This method jointly models structural ensembles across states and shared deuterium loss, offering an interpretation strategy when loss-correction controls are unavailable.

en: Differential HDX-MS connects protein conformational populations with experimental exchange signals. This method jointly models structural ensembles across states and shared deuterium loss, offering an interpretation strategy when loss-correction controls are unavailable.

Accessible journal listings, publication metadata and indexes covered proteomics, small molecules and lipids, ion mobility, imaging and signal processing. Some publisher and preprint articles were inaccessible; the interpretations below retain explicit abstract-level and validation limits.

papers.title: Multi-Ensemble Reweighting Enables Structural Interpretation of Differential HDX-MS

commentary.zh: 该方法联合重加权多个结构集合，把各状态共享、随肽段变化的氘损失纳入模型，无需先实验测定损失；摘要报告在合成基准、LeuT 和 NCX_Mj 差异 HDX-MS 数据以及 AlphaFold3 结构集合上恢复有实验支持的构象变化。对研发的启发是联合估计结构群体与测量干扰，但共享损失假设、先验集合覆盖及可辨识性仍需全文检验，不能将摘要所述适用范围扩展等同于普遍准确率保证。
commentary.en: The method jointly reweights structural ensembles while modeling shared, peptide-dependent deuterium loss without requiring separate experimental loss measurements. Its abstract reports supported conformational changes in synthetic benchmarks, LeuT and NCX_Mj differential HDX-MS, including AlphaFold3-derived ensembles; joint treatment of populations and measurement nuisance is promising, but shared-loss assumptions, ensemble coverage and identifiability require full-text assessment rather than a universal accuracy claim.
